description: Real-time rolling-window rPPG detector evaluating cardiovascular skin reflectance consistency in live surveillance video feeds. Operates as a secondary physiological signal alongside the frame-level edge CNN classifier.

performance.measured_on: Intel Core i7 / RTX 3050 (CPU-only classical CHROM algorithm)

known_failure_modes.condition: motionless faces (static images, printed photos, freeze-frames)
known_failure_modes.effect: resolved M2-L1: now reports status 'motionless_face' with neutral score 0.5 instead of incorrectly classifying as 100% synthetic

known_failure_modes.condition: initial streaming buffer accumulation period (first 6.0 seconds of stream)
known_failure_modes.effect: resolved M2-L2: now explicitly reports 'warming_up' status with progress percentage instead of silent stall or premature verdict

known_failure_modes.condition: face tracking lost or face occluded during live stream
known_failure_modes.effect: resolved M2-L3: now returns 'not_applicable' status without falling back to noisy whole-frame RGB average

reliability_notes: Best used as a secondary physiological content verification signal in live surveillance feeds, fused with frame-level edge CNN classifiers. Not a sole authority — requires at least 6 seconds of clear, well-lit, unoccluded face footage for a reliable reading.
